ABOUT US

Trading company specialized in imports and exports of fertilizers and agrochemicals

The management of the company has deep experience in the fertilizers market as well as chemical industry. In addition, management has extensive knowledge in the financial market enabling us to offer international financing solution for our clients.

Ferticorp was founded based on its shareholders experience. However the company was founded recently, our experience comes from many years visiting and meeting the main producers of fertilizers around the world, participating in many specialized fairs and all IFAs during the last 15 years.

15years meeting the main producers of fertilizers

Mission

Share with our clients the experience in international Market including planning actions, logistics, customs and tax advising. Seeking to fulfill the different regulations and laws in each different country, advising our clients and international suppliers.

Excellence

We focus on the commitment with current regulations, searching the best services to our clients. One of our major objectives is to avoid barriers during the all import processes and significant reduction in costs. Ferticorp is a facilitator for international business, acting intermediating commercial relations between suppliers and clients in the most safety way for both parties. In a global scenario where the necessity of increase of volumes and margins it is very important optimization of time, flexibility, dynamism and mainly a healthy partnership.

RESPONSIBILITY

Governance, transparency and agility

Governance

FERTICORP is a company with special attention for corporate governance. Our procedures have as main objective to recover and guarantee the reliability for its shareholders. We keep a set of efficient mechanisms for incentives and monitoring for compliance reasons to have a team commited with the conduct and interest of the shareholders.

Transparency

FERTICORP maintain a broad relationship with various producers, it is our duty provide the commercial alignment between clients and suppliers through a correct way without having any doubt about the all completed process. The transparency in the process is an essencial value for our clients to keep a long commercial relationship with FERTICORP.

Agility

Each transaction performed by FERTICORP is a challenge as we have always the commitment of agility, transparency and simplicity. The focus on its business, the knowledge, and the domain in the import process by FERTICORP, make the business flows quickly and with agility. Our forecast for shipping and arrival of fertilizers has to be totally reliable and the presentation of documents clear and simple. Our team is very experienced and specialized which enable us to attend each process with exclusivity since the beginning until conclusion.

OUR SERVICES

The services offered by Ferticorp can be described as follows

Supplier

International supplier needs to increase sales around the world, however does not have enough knowledge about the suitability of clients from different countries.

Ferticorp

Ferticorp owner of this capability, bring both partners together, ensuring the best result for clients and suppliers.

Client

On the other hand, clients are looking for new opportunities and new suppliers with quality products and guaranties for a safety delivery but can not reach them directly.

Advantages for importing through a trading company:

Supervision of all import process, including quality controll, customs, shipping procedures, documentation, consolidation, warehousing, etc.

Best way for communication between supplier and cliente as the company has high level quality in its international staff.

Offer of a more diversified variety of products as the company maintains commercial relationship with the main producers round the world.

Helps the client to keep the focus in its main business as Ferticorp can offer a complete package of services related to the import process.

CCC Machinery is an affiliated company of Ferrostaal

Ferrostaal is a global provider of industrial services in plant construction and engineering. As a technology-independent system integrator, the company offers development and management of projects, financial planning and construction services for turnkey installations in the segments of Petrochemicals, Power, Renewables, Oil & Gas and Special Projects. As a supplier-independent full service provider, Ferrostaal assembles complex modules for automotive manufacturers and suppliers, and trades as an independent sales and service partner with piping equipment and machines and installations in printing, plastics, packaging and recycling. Ferrostaal employs around 4,300 people in more than 40 countries. In 2011, its annual turnover amounted to around 1 billion euro. Ferrostaal is a company of MPC Industries GmbH (Hamburg, Germany). Since 2012 CCC Machinery is an affiliated company of Ferrostaal.

In several sales departments CCC Machinery handles business with Machines, Plant, Technical Products and Raw Materials mostly in combination with granting and/or arranging structured Export Finance solutions for its customers in the markets of the African continent ("Department Technical Export South"), in South East Asia and Turkey ("Department Technical Export East"), in Europe ("Department Technical Export Europe") and Latin America ("Department Technical Export West"). CCC Machinery additionally also supplies turnkey industrial Repair-/Maintenance Shops and Laboratories ("Department Workshops and Laboratories") to customers of various industries.
